C0152.title: Selling Accounts Lands Man in Prison: Huaiyuan Prosecutor Details Social Media Account Resale Case Under PRC’s “Aiding Cybercrime” Law
C0152.summary: Between 2022 and 2024, Defendant A knowingly sold over 200 social media accounts—including Douyin, QQ, and Kuaishou profiles—to buyers engaged in telecom fraud, resulting in one victim being defrauded of more than 1.8 million yuan. A earned over 30,000 yuan in illegal proceeds and was convicted of aiding information network criminal activities; he received a one-year prison term suspended for one
